text.autoconfig.seamlessores.title: Seamless Ores
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.gran: Generate granite-backed ore where granite would already contain ore.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.dior: Generate diorite-backed ore where diorite would already contain ore.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.ande: Generate andesite-backed ore where andesite would already contain ore.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.tuff: Generate tuff-backed ore instead of the deepslate-textured ore vanilla puts in tuff.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.drip: Dripstone caves cover their walls in dripstone around the ore. This makes that ore match.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.lush: Lush Caves clay and moss (removes ore)
Ore left bare in a Lush Caves clay floor or moss carpet becomes clay or moss, so a
little ore is removed there. Bone meal on moss works exactly as in vanilla.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.cinn: Gold, silver, iron, redstone and sulfide ores inside the Sulfur Caves' cinnabar,
How much cinnabar ore forms, in percent of the default. 0 places none,
300 places three times as much. Applies to newly generated chunks.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.sulf: No ore in or against the sulfur and cinnabar of the Sulfur Caves, including the large
On this version the Sulfur Caves come from Vanilla Backport.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.basa: Puts gold and quartz in basalt. Vanilla generates NEITHER there,
so this ADDS ore - most noticeably in basalt deltas. Turn off for vanilla amounts.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.blac: Puts gold and quartz in blackstone. Vanilla generates NEITHER there,
so this ADDS ore. Turn off for vanilla amounts.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.over: How much copper generates, as a percent of vanilla. 100 leaves vanilla untouched.
Reduces the NUMBER of veins rather than their size, so a vein you find is still
worth mining out. This changes vanilla generation, unlike everything else here.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.drip: Dripstone caves get a second, larger copper vein on top of the usual one, and no
other biome does - roughly three times the copper anywhere else, in vanilla.
0 gives dripstone caves exactly the same copper as every other biome.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.oreV: The big copper and iron veins are packed with granite and tuff. This makes their ore
match that filler. Cosmetic only - the amount of ore is identical either way.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.geol: Keeps ores out of rock they could never form in, such as coal in granite or
diamond in diorite: that ore stays plain rock, so there is less of it. Off by default.
Applies to newly generated chunks, from the next world load.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.crea: Generate host-matched zinc ore. Does nothing unless Create is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.myth: Generate host-matched Mythic Metals ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
Generate host-matched Mythic Upgrades ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.zinc: How large each zinc vein is. Create's own value is 12; lower means less zinc.
Create spreads zinc evenly from Y -63 to 70, so it is equally common everywhere.
Set this to 12 to leave Create's generation completely untouched.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.neth: Scatter Mythic Upgrades ruby and sapphire through basalt deltas, as rarely as
ancient debris. Ruby sits around Y 28, sapphire around Y 12, never surface exposed.
How many gems each find holds. 3 matches ancient debris exactly, 6 is double.
Higher values make finds both larger and easier to come across.
How big each nether gold or quartz vein is, as a percent of vanilla. 100 is vanilla.
Below its thin basalt crust a delta is netherrack, so some of what you dig through
there is vanilla's own ore. Unlike the rarity setting, this affects that too.
One in this many basalt or blackstone veins becomes ore. 1 converts every vein.
Basalt deltas run twice the usual gold and quartz, and are almost all basalt,
so without this nearly every vein there converted. Vanilla ore is unaffected.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.bast: Keep basalt and blackstone ore out of bastion remnants.
Bastions are built from those blocks, so without this their walls can
turn into ore and invite you to mine the structure apart.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.sile: Generate host-matched Silent's Gems ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
Purely a restyle: the amount of gem ore is identical either way.
Puts Silent's Gems nether gems in basalt and blackstone. That mod generates them in
netherrack only, so this ADDS ore, most noticeably in basalt deltas.
Turn off to leave the Nether exactly as Silent's Gems generates it.
One in this many basalt or blackstone gem veins becomes ore. 1 converts every vein.
Separate from the Nether page's dial, so gems and gold can be balanced apart.
How big each nether gem vein is, as a percent of the mod's own value. 100 is untouched.
As on the Nether page, this also shrinks the mod's own netherrack veins.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.dens: Generate host-matched Dense Mekanism ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
Mekanism's own ore has its own setting, above.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.powa: Generate host-matched uraninite ore. Does nothing unless Powah is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.tfmg: Generate host-matched TFMG ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.expO: Generate host-matched experience ore. Does nothing unless Exp Ores is installed.
Includes basalt and blackstone, where that mod already generates it. Adds no ore.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.iceA: Generate host-matched sapphire and silver ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.ener: Generate host-matched tin ore. Does nothing unless Energized Power is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.thin: Generate host-matched gleaming ore. Does nothing unless Things is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.sile: Generate host-matched bort ore. Does nothing unless Silent Gear is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.crea: Generate host-matched thorium ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.extr: Generate host-matched yellorite ore. Does nothing unless Extreme Reactors is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.mode: Generate host-matched Modern Industrialization ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.myst: Generate host-matched inferium and prosperity ore. Does nothing unless the mod is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.occu: Generate host-matched silver ore. Does nothing unless Occultism is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.tech: Generate host-matched Tech Reborn ore. Does nothing unless Tech Reborn is installed.
Puts cinnabar, pyrite and sphalerite in basalt and blackstone. Tech Reborn generates them
in netherrack only, so this ADDS ore, thinned by the Nether tab's rarity and vein size.
Turn off to leave the Nether exactly as Tech Reborn generates it.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.extr: Puts benitoite in basalt and blackstone. Extreme Reactors generates it in netherrack
only, so this ADDS ore, thinned by the Nether tab's rarity and vein size.
Turn off to leave the Nether exactly as Extreme Reactors generates it.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.malu: Generate host-matched soulstone, natural quartz, brilliance and blazing quartz ore. Does nothing unless Malum is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.oreg: Generate host-matched lead and silver ore. Does nothing unless Oreganized is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.meka: Generate host-matched Mekanism ore (osmium, tin, lead, uranium and fluorite). Does nothing unless Mekanism is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.imme: Generate host-matched aluminum, lead, nickel, silver and uranium ore. Does nothing unless Immersive Engineering is installed.
text.autoconfig.seamlessores.option.cobb: Generate host-matched evolution stone ore. Does nothing unless Cobblemon is installed.
Puts fire stone ore in basalt and blackstone. Cobblemon generates it in netherrack
only, so this ADDS ore, thinned by the Nether tab's rarity and vein size.
Turn off to leave the Nether exactly as Cobblemon generates it.
